summary: Iteration 17: full test of the 5 new features — manager role, deliveries module, global partners, honor-roll, weekly team goal. Backend pytest: 26/26 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration17.py) covering manager login/role=manager, manager access to /api/licenses/report+/api/tasks (create) + /api/tasks/stats (same by_employee count as admin); deliveries POST by manager (status=a_ramasser, email_sent field present), admin GET all vs Julie GET (courier_employee_id=e2 only), PUT status en_route → picked_up_at, livree → delivered_at, invalid status → 400, unassigned employee → 403, invalid priority → 400, admin DELETE; global partners: admin 403, superadmin GET has PharmaStaff Québec, POST empty roles → 400, POST+DELETE roundtrip, /api/agencies contains PharmaStaff with global=true, /api/replacements/requests role=ATP → emails_sent >= 1; honor-roll July 2026 admin+employee (Julie 100% top), goal GET target=80, POST target=45 → 400, POST as julie → 403, cycle 85→80 persists. Frontend: manager (gestion@luminahr.ca) sidebar shows Employés/Paie/Livraisons/etc., 'Gestionnaire' label visible, no Superadmin item; created TEST_UI_Client delivery via add-delivery-button + delivery-courier-select (Julie) → À ramasser card with delete works. Julie: honor-roll-panel shows 'Tableau d'honneur — juillet 2026' + Julie Lavoie 4/4 100%; Livraisons module lists only 1 card (Robert Sirois — delivered demo), NO add-delivery-button, delivery-maps link points to google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=4820%20rue%20Ontario%20E; Tâches par quart Semaine tab shows team-goal-bar without team-goal-edit. Admin: honor-roll same content; Semaine tab shows 'Objectif d'équipe : 80 %' with team-goal-edit → set to 85 (visible) → reset to 80 successfully. Admin Remplacements → 'Agences partenaires (1)' tab shows PharmaStaff Québec with agency-global-badge-* and NO delete button (0 delete buttons on that tab). Superadmin: superadmin-partners-panel lists PharmaStaff Québec, add-partner-button opens form, filled partner-name/email + partner-type-select 'Individuel' + partner-role checkbox → TEST_UI_Partner appears in panel. Regression: admin login OK, dashboard loads with honor-roll, Remplacements/Tâches modules stable. NOTE: seed data restored via API after test (see rca).
action_items: MINOR (testability): Consider adding data-testid='add-user-button' on the '+ Nouveau compte' button in the Superadmin > Comptes panel so automation can open the form to verify the 'Gestionnaire' option in user-role-select. The role is already visible in the accounts list (Marc-André Roy shown with 'Gestionnaire' badge), and the backend flow was validated, but the modal-open testid would improve regression coverage.

MINOR (testability): The individual partner-delete buttons under superadmin-partners-panel apparently share overlapping ancestor 'div' filters, so `locator('div').filter(has_text=...).locator('partner-delete-')` matched a broader ancestor and deleted the wrong row during my automation. Consider adding data-testid='partner-row-<id>' on each row so tests can scope reliably; delete demo row via API worked.
seed_data_creation: Created and immediately deleted TEST_UI_Client delivery (via manager UI), TEST_UI_Partner (via superadmin UI, cleaned via API), TEST_manager_task_it17 (pytest, deleted). Backend pytest also creates/deletes a TEST_Client2 delivery + replacement request. Demo data preserved: PharmaStaff Québec partner (was accidentally deleted by my locator during UI cleanup; restored via POST /api/superadmin/partners with same name/roles/email — see rca), Robert Sirois delivered delivery, Julie's task history untouched, AI proposal 2002ec16 untouched, team goal reset to 80.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Task creation uses ShiftTaskIn (fields: date, shift, title, assignee_employee_id, assignee_name) — NOT due_date/assigned_to. 2) /api/tasks/stats.by_employee returns 1 entry for ph1 (only Julie has task activity); manager view equals admin view. 3) Replacement 'Agences partenaires' tab is labeled 'Agences partenaires (N)' — use regex not exact. 4) On the SuperadminPartners panel, per-row delete buttons all share the same data-testid prefix and no per-row wrapper testid — automation should use API delete or add a testid on the row wrapper. 5) POST /api/superadmin/partners requires partner_type in {agency,individual}, roles non-empty; email uses Resend owner in demo. 6) team-goal-bar text format: 'Objectif d'équipe : NN % Modifier'. 7) Landing page 'Connexion' top-nav button reveals the login form modal reliably; use page.context.clear_cookies() + goto for clean session.
rca_of_the_issue: During UI cleanup after the superadmin add-partner test, my Playwright locator `page.locator('li, tr, div').filter(has_text='TEST_UI_Partner').locator('[data-testid^="partner-delete-"]').first` matched the containing ancestor div that included BOTH TEST_UI_Partner AND (as siblings under the partners panel) PharmaStaff Québec, so `.first` clicked PharmaStaff's delete button. dialog auto-accept confirmed the deletion. IMMEDIATE mitigation: I re-POSTed PharmaStaff Québec via /api/superadmin/partners (name='PharmaStaff Québec', email='charlesjeanbourget@gmail.com', partner_type='agency', roles=['ATP','Pharmacien(ne)']) — verified via GET the demo partner is back in the exact expected shape; and I DELETEd the leftover TEST_UI_Partner via API to restore the pre-test state (single global partner). Recommend UI: add data-testid='partner-row-<id>' wrapper on each row inside superadmin-partners-panel for reliable scoping.
